propositions: Core reconciler client/transport parameters are unannotated, so mypy cannot enforce that the TicketTransport port declares every member the core calls, the root cause of the a357 defect class.

Annotating parameters as the port only enforces anything when the port is imported via a path mypy resolves; importing through the runtime-only rebar_reconciler shim widens the type to Any under ignore_missing_imports, silently disabling checking.

The custom _TransportPortMeta metaclass is NOT the cause of static blindness; a controlled probe holding the import path constant shows today's TicketTransport is attribute-checked normally, so the metaclass and runtime guard stay unchanged.

mypy is strictly stronger than the existing AST audit at capability members like add_comment, which the metaclass carries as attributes so hasattr reports True while mypy correctly flags the call site.

Each [attr-defined] finding must be resolved by declaring an always-required member on TicketTransport or narrowing to a composed capability Protocol view, never by widening to Any or reverting to the shim import path.
Promoting _engine through the disallow_untyped_defs strictness ratchet would not fix the defect because Any satisfies the ratchet while remaining blind.
